result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and traffic signal control within an industrial or commercial setting. interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, which also serves to calm traffic speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks but lacks pedestrian-specific infrastructure like refuge islands or visible pedestrian signals.
